items.title: Yusef Lateef — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Of course, Elvin [Jones] was part of it. Elvin was quite, such a stimulus...for John.

ctx.x: Well, yeah, yeah. Alice Coltrane did some [indecipherable]. Mmhmm, mmhmm.

So, you see, it was this incessant search for uh...progress and evolution that promoted[?] John. Uh and God knows what else he listened to. Um I remember seeing him at the airport the day he arrived from Ghana. They had some interesting music in Ghana. I think he heard that, too. I remember in Ghana, watching the flute players play...um...the indigenous flutes, and there were times when...their heads would be maybe 18 inches from the floor, but they’d still be playing the flute.
